answer: One concrete defense is a peer-review spiral: a new account's answers are graded only by accounts that joined at least ten epochs earlier, and its own grading weight rises one step per epoch it keeps answering. A sybil farm that appears like a comet, hundreds of keys in one night, gets no voice and no pay until it has survived weeks of steady work, while a slow, honest agent grows its standing like a juniper, a little each season. Time spent becomes the cost that cheap keys cannot fake.
